March 5, 2018 - By Vivian Park 
Goldman Sachs Group Inc increased its stake in Nextera Energy Partners Lp (NEP) by 6.73% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Goldman Sachs Group Inc bought 22,334 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 354,066 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $14.27M, up from 331,732 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Goldman Sachs Group Inc who had been investing in Nextera Energy Partners Lp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.06B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.44% or $0.17 during the last trading session, reaching $38.05. About 71,892 shares traded. NextEra Energy Partners, LP (NYSE:NEP) has risen 18.85% since March 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.15% the S&P500. 
Eidelman Virant Capital decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 29.87% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Eidelman Virant Capital sold 6,949 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,315 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.51 million, down from 23,264 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Eidelman Virant Capital who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $897.78B market cap company. The stock increased 0.41% or $0.7269 during the last trading session, reaching $176.9369. About 17.73M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Eidelman Virant Capital, which manages about $285.00 million and $168.24M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Pfizer Inc (NYSE:PFE) by 123,500 shares to 145,930 shares, valued at $5.21 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Franklin Finl Network Inc by 43,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 83,470 shares, and has risen its stake in Reading International Inc (NASDAQ:RDI).

AAPL’s profit will be $13.80B for 16.26 P/E if the $2.72 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.08% negative EPS growth.
